answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the river is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
